what.text: This page follows refugees from Belarus in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 19462 refugees from Belarus.
Poland hosts the largest share, 58.7%, followed by the United States, Germany and France.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Belarus, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1994 at 37 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
